newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian share activity perks but shares dip.
newsitem.headline: Estonian share activity perks but shares dip.

text.p: The Estonian stock exchange recorded good volumes on Friday with some large blocks moved but the market was mixed and again lacking direction, dealers said.
"Next week should be quiet again, this market has exhausted itself," one trader said.
Total trade on the main list was 43 million kroons with the Talse 0.22 percent down at 251.83.
Hansapank was most active to lose 0.32 kroons to 130.85 kroons on trade worth 16.6 million kroons.
Traders said some large blocks in Hansapank changed hands, one for around 42,000 shares.
Hoiupank turned over 13.6 million kroons to close 0.05 kroons lower on 132.25 kroons.
The free market turned over 4.7 million kroons with privatisation vouchers most active on three million kroons to close slightly lower on 0.271 kroons, down 0.003 kroons.
